prompts.A:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: production game background, NOT a mockup. Reimagine the supplied Railroad Tycoon 3 museum room as a luxurious detailed photorealistic 3D render. Output a true 3840x1600 ultrawide 4K-width image. Preserve the identity and exact NUMBER and ordering of the foreground display cases. The central 4:3 area contains the original scene with clickable cases in their reference locations; naturally extend the architecture on both sides to 12:5 with useful museum details. Do not stretch or crop the original room. Keep the same camera elevation, vanishing point and case placements. Elegant walnut carvings, polished brass, highly detailed machinery, believable glass, luminous warm daylight, rich restrained colors. No UI, no arrows, no emergency exit signs, no extra display cases, no added labels or typography, no watermark. Static environment plate; all navigation will be drawn in code.
ROOM A, dawn of railways: deep green coffered ceiling and walnut columns; red wooden stagecoach on left, early black steam locomotive with tall green flared chimney on right. Exactly FIVE cases, left to right: dark ironwork cart case, narrow cream rectangular case, tall walnut arched case, ornate dark case, green case with red striped sides. Include the ornate suspended ceiling fan motor near upper-left-center but NO FAN BLADES: a separate animated blade layer will be rendered by the game. Keep the ceiling around the fan simple enough to accept the moving layer.
